requirements.text: Every planned model change is recorded in the change log of the model inventory before implementation in production.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The change memorandum describes the change and rationale, affected components and documents, internal and regulatory classification with analysis, quantitative impact, required validation and implementation plan.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Related changes planned together or addressing the same deficiency are recorded and assessed as a single change.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Every change is classified by internal materiality and, for models requiring supervisory permission, by regulatory class (A, B or C).
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A change is classified as internally material if it alters methodology, drivers, default or target definition, range of application or use, introduces a new material input source, or exceeds the output-impact thresholds of §5.2(e).
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The change impact on aggregate model output at the most recent reference date and on grade or class assignments is quantified against the 5% and 10% thresholds.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The regulatory class follows Delegated Regulation 529/2014: Class A if a qualitative material-change criterion is met or RWEA decreases by at least 1.5% overall or 15% in the range of application.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal provision implementing Delegated Regulation (EU) No 529/2014. Thresholds and criteria restated from knowledge of the RTS (Art. 4 and Annex I); verify against EUR-Lex and check whether a CRR3 successor RTS under CRR Art. 143(5) applies.

requirements.text: The quantitative impact is calculated on the same most recent reference date before and after the change, at Bank-wide RWEA level and at the level of the rating system’s range of application.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Changes are not split, sequenced or combined to avoid a higher classification, and the cumulative impact of changes since the last permission or full validation is assessed.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The change classification proposed by the model developer is approved by MRM, with disagreements escalated to the MRC.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Where the classification is uncertain, the higher internal materiality or regulatory class is applied.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Every internally material change is independently validated before implementation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A Class A or Class B change is validated before the application or ex ante notification is submitted, and the validation report is part of the submission.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: For a non-material change to a Tier 1 model, Model Validation decides within ten business days whether a review before implementation is required.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A re-validation is triggered by an unresolved red monitoring outcome, a material change in portfolio composition or external environment, a relevant regulatory change or a change in intended use.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The next validation is full-scope where cumulative non-material changes since the last full validation together meet the internal materiality criteria.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: An internally material change passes gates G1 to G4 and is approved by the authority for the model tier; a Class A change is approved by the MRC before submission.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A non-material change is approved by the model owner after MRM has confirmed its classification, and the new model version is recorded in the inventory.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A Class A change is used to calculate own funds requirements only after the ECB has granted permission.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A Class B change is notified to the ECB at least two months before intended implementation and is not implemented before that period ends or if the ECB indicates that permission is required.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the institution towards the ECB; evidenced in the ex ante notification and its submission records, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Two-month ex ante notification period restated from Delegated Regulation 529/2014 as known; confirm article reference and whether a CRR3 successor RTS changes it.

requirements.text: A Class C change is notified to the ECB after implementation, at the latest in the quarterly aggregated ex post notification following implementation.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the institution towards the ECB; evidenced in the quarterly ex post notification, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Quarterly aggregation is an internal rule; confirm consistency with the ex post notification timing in Delegated Regulation 529/2014 and current ECB practice.

requirements.text: ECB obligations, limitations and recommendations attached to a permission are recorded in the inventory with owner and deadline and tracked as MRC conditions.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The application package contains the change description, classification and impact analysis, self-assessment against CRR, RTS 2022/439, EBA guidelines and ECB guide, approved MDD and RDS documentation, validation report, implementation plan, deficiencies list and approvals.
requirements.level_reason: Content requirement for the supervisory application; evidenced in the application package submitted to the ECB, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: MRM completes an application readiness review at least six weeks before submission, confirming completeness, consistency of figures across documents and use of approved document versions.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the MRM function in the application process; evidenced in the application readiness review, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: An application is not submitted with an open high-severity finding on the changed model unless the finding, impact and remediation plan are disclosed and the MRC has approved submission.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the institution in the supervisory application process; evidenced in the application submission and MRC minutes, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Data, code and documentation supporting the application remain available, and the RDS and model estimation remain reproducible, throughout the ECB assessment.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A post-implementation review comparing realised with estimated impact is performed within six months of implementing an internally material change and reported to MRM.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.
